A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same DiffHDR work, with complete, readable main text and Appendices A–E. Pages 2–28 have identical extracted text and rendered appearance; differences are confined to page 1.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark evaluations in Tables 1–3, component ablations in Tables 4–5, and additional qualitative, VAE, precision, and control analyses in the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains the original experimental results in Tables 1–5 and the main-text and appendix analyses.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same Log-Gamma mapping, VACE backbone, LoRA adaptation, exposure masks, context-focused cross-attention, and reference-image conditioning. No algorithmic component or procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Polyhaven-derived training data and evaluate on SI-HDR, Cinematic Video, held-out synthetic videos, Pexels videos, and Veo2-generated videos. Task and scenario coverage is unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains HDRCNN, MaskHDR, SingleHDR, and LEDiff; Tables 2–3 retain SingleHDR and LEDiff. Comparator membership in the qualitative comparisons and ablations is also unchanged.

E3.justification: Sample counts, held-out evaluation data, metrics, Reinhard preprocessing, training resolution, 10,000-step training budget, and testing procedures remain identical in Sections 3–4 and the appendices.

E4.justification: Both versions retain the mapping, augmentation, mask, and prompting ablations, along with appendix analyses of VAE finetuning, BF16 banding, and cross-attention control strength. No analysis is added, removed, or revised.

E5.justification: Uncertainty reporting is unchanged. Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests for the performance results.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–5 and all qualitative results remain identical. For example, DiffHDR's Table 2 FOVVDP scores remain 6.89 on Cinematic Video and 7.65 on synthetic video.

T1.justification: Equations 1–8, the mapping-ablation formula, and their mathematical definitions and assumptions are unchanged. No theoretical derivation or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract's scientific claims, introduction's contribution list, and conclusion retain the same novelty, performance, generalization, and controllability claims. Removing the project-page invitation does not alter those claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations remain identical, including the explanation for HDR-VDP3 performance, ambiguity in clipped-region reconstruction, VAE finetuning oversmoothing, and BF16 banding. No substantive qualification or limitation changes.

D1.justification: v3 removes the abstract's project-page URL, eliminating an explicit access pointer present in v1. Implementation, hardware, hyperparameter, and captioning details remain unchanged; the PDFs do not establish any change in actual code or data availability.

R1.justification: Section 2, the 114 references, and the positioning against prior HDR and generative-model research are unchanged.

P1.justification: The abstract loses its final project-page invitation, and the arXiv version/date stamp is updated. All other wording, section organization, and appendix structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The shortened abstract slightly changes first-page vertical spacing, and the version/date stamp changes appearance. All figures, tables, captions, and layouts on pages 2–28 are identical.

improvement.justification: The scientific content, experimental evidence, explanations, and appendices are unchanged. Removing the project-page pointer slightly reduces navigation convenience but does not establish loss of research resources; the remaining first-page edits are cosmetic. These changes do not meaningfully alter overall paper quality.
